svg.title: Saved-snapshot replay workflow
svg.desc: An intended workflow from original earlier feeds through Lab and frozen CP2, then later feeds and Oracle diagnosis, Evolve review, and a later matched comparison. The recorded first run stopped at Lab cross-correlation.

svg.text: Original six acquired feeds + CALC at two times; no synthetic substitute.
Recorded full-feed runs have no frozen CP1, CP2 or forecast; see current status.
Oracle explains the frozen forecast against later truth; only a separate matched comparison can assess a reviewed change.
Research prototype. This is not financial advice.
